pending_interview.question: You have a list of intervals representing calendar events, each as a [start, end] pair (integers, end exclusive). Given a new meeting request [s, e], write a function that returns the merged list of intervals after inserting the new event — handling all overlap cases correctly. Then: what is the time complexity of your solution, and is there a scenario where you could do better than O(n)?
